1. About Penya Collective

These Terms and Conditions govern your use of the Penya Collective website and any purchase made through it. By accessing our website or placing an order, you agree to be bound by these terms. Please read them carefully before purchasing.

Penya Collective operates from Heidelberg, Germany. For all enquiries: info@penya.africa.

2. Products and Pricing

All prices are displayed in Euros (€). We reserve the right to amend prices at any time without prior notice. The price applied to your order is the price confirmed at the time of checkout.

Colour and texture disclaimer: We make every effort to represent our products accurately through photography. However, colours and textures may vary between your screen and the actual garment, depending on display settings, lighting conditions, and the natural characteristics of the fabric. Variation of this nature is not considered a defect and does not entitle you to a return or refund.

Availability disclaimer: Penya Collective produces in small batches. We cannot guarantee that items shown on the website are available at all times. If an item you have ordered is unavailable, we will notify you promptly and provide a full refund.

3. Orders and Payment

Submitting an order constitutes an offer to purchase. We reserve the right to decline any order at our discretion. Your order is accepted, and a contract formed, only when we dispatch the item and send you a dispatch confirmation.

Payment is required in full at checkout. We accept major credit and debit cards and other methods displayed at checkout. All transactions are processed securely via our payment provider.

4. Shipping

We ship worldwide. Free shipping applies to all orders over €200. Orders below this threshold are subject to standard shipping rates shown at checkout.

Catalog items are typically dispatched within 1–2 business days. Estimated delivery time from dispatch is approximately one week, depending on destination.

Bespoke and custom orders carry longer, variable lead times. You will be kept informed at every stage of production. We will not dispatch until the piece meets our quality standards and you have been updated on the expected timeline.

Delivery estimates are not guaranteed. Delays caused by customs authorities, carriers, or events outside our control do not entitle you to cancel an order or claim compensation.

Customers outside the European Union may be subject to import duties and local taxes on delivery. These charges are determined by the destination country's customs authority and are the sole responsibility of the recipient.

5. Returns and Refunds

We accept returns within 14 days of delivery for items that are unworn, unaltered, and returned with original tags attached. To initiate a return, contact us at info@penya.africa with your order number and reason for return.

Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer, except where the item is faulty or incorrectly sent. Refunds are processed within 10 business days of receiving and inspecting the returned item.

Bespoke and custom-made orders are non-refundable, as they are produced specifically to your specifications. The sole exception is a genuine manufacturing defect, in which case we will repair or replace the item at our cost. A non-refundable deposit is required to commence any bespoke commission.

Final-sale items are not eligible for return or exchange under any circumstances.

6. Bespoke and Custom Orders

Bespoke commissions are subject to a separate agreement confirmed in writing by email. A non-refundable deposit (typically 50% of the total price) is required before work commences. The balance is due upon completion, before dispatch.

Lead times for bespoke work are estimates only. We will communicate any changes to the timeline promptly. Delays in bespoke production do not entitle you to cancel the order or recover your deposit.

7. Intellectual Property

All content on this website — including photography, copy, design, brand identity, and the work of our partner designers — is the intellectual property of Penya Collective or the respective designer. No content may be reproduced, distributed, or used commercially without prior written permission.

8. Website Use

You agree to use this website lawfully and not to engage in any conduct that could damage, disable, or impair the website or interfere with any other party's use of it. We reserve the right to restrict or terminate access to the website at our discretion.

9. Disclaimer of Warranties

This website and its content are provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not warrant that the website will be uninterrupted, error-free, or free from viruses or other harmful components. We are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential loss arising from use of or inability to use this website.

10. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Penya Collective's total liability to you for any claim arising from your use of the website or purchase of products shall not exceed the value of the order in question.

11. Governing Law

These Terms and Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany. Any disputes arising from or connected with these terms shall be subject to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Heidelberg, Germany.

12. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms and Conditions at any time. The most current version will always be available on this page. Continued use of the website following any changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised terms.

13. Contact

For any questions about these terms, email us at info@penya.africa or message us on WhatsApp.

Last updated: March 2026
